ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth-and-valais.title: Ticino Tremola Weekend Warmth + Valais Glacier Weekend Seed
ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth-and-valais.region: Gotthard Tremola cobbled to Furka glacier

waypoints.name: Andermatt base check
waypoints.advice: Andermatt base check is where the day begins. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Gotthard Tremola cobbled road, climbing 662 m.

waypoints.name: Gotthard Tremola cobbled road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2106 m here. The road climbs 662 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 12 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Airolo fuel stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Airolo fuel stop
waypoints.advice: Fill up here — 475 km left and no pump marked after this. You lose 931 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Lago Maggiore evening base, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Lago Maggiore evening base
waypoints.advice: Lago Maggiore evening base, early in the day at 200 m. You lose 975 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Lukmanier return option, climbing 1715 m.

waypoints.name: Lukmanier return option
waypoints.advice: Lukmanier return option tops the climb at 1915 m. The road climbs 1715 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Back to Andermatt, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Back to Andermatt
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 581 km. You lose 471 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Andermatt overnight option.

waypoints.name: Andermatt overnight option
waypoints.advice: 317 km in you reach Andermatt overnight option. Next is Furka glacier road, climbing 985 m.

waypoints.name: Furka glacier road
waypoints.advice: 2429 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 985 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 14 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Gletsch historic junction, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Gletsch historic junction
waypoints.advice: Gletsch historic junction sits at 423 km, late in the day. You lose 670 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Grimsel reservoirs, climbing 405 m.

waypoints.name: Grimsel reservoirs
waypoints.advice: Grimsel reservoirs tops the climb at 2164 m. The road climbs 405 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 13 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Brig food and fuel, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Brig food and fuel
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 1473 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Back to Andermatt, climbing 753 m.

waypoints.name: Back to Andermatt
waypoints.advice: Back to Andermatt closes the day. The road climbs 753 m over at least 59 km before it, steadily.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 2 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Nufenen Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 94 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 144 km. 753 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth-and-valais.story: Out of Andermatt and back again: 581 km, roughly 11 h 10 in the saddle. It goes by way of Airolo and Lago Maggiore evening. The climbs: Gotthard Tremola cobbled road, Lukmanier  option, Furka glacier road and Grimsel reservoirs. It tops out at 2,429 m. Gotthard Pass, Lukmanier Pass, Furka Pass and Grimsel Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
